description: WebBuilder Site is the zero-to-revenue 4.2 SKU. On purchase, the fulfillment pipeline creates a WebBuilder studio project from the buyer's business details, renders the 4.1 static HTML site bundle (business name, tel: phone CTA, 'Book a consultation' CTA, lead-capture form), publishes the preview lane, and records the buyer in webbuilder_crm as a pack_purchase contact. The revenue event is marked delivered only when the bundle and the CRM record both exist; any failure marks it failed and raises an alert. Price is $497 (49700 cents), decided by TOA decision z2r-webbuilder-price-20261023 and enforced server-side from PACK_SKUS — client-supplied prices are ignored.
